summary: GreenByte Labs invoice INV-2026-047 blocked: PO/Invoice line-item & pricing discrepancy causing payment hold
description:
Issue summary:
Vendor: GreenByte Labs
Vendor invoice: INV-2026-047 dated 2026-03-05 for USD 72,400.00
Associated PO: PO-7789 created 2026-02-27 for USD 69,000.00, services (SaaS onboarding & training) line items.

Impact:
- Payment to vendor is currently on hold in the AP system due to line-item/quantity/price mismatch.
- Vendor is requesting net-30 payment; delay is affecting onboarding timeline and leads to escalation from vendor account manager.
- Finance cannot auto-approve; manual intervention required (change order or corrected invoice).

Environment:
- AP system: BillMatrix (prod-us-east) integration to accounting (NetLedger)
- Procurement system: ProcureFlow (prod)

Steps to reproduce / triage performed:
1) AP queued invoice after automated validation failed (early mismatch rule).
2) Finance AP analyst verified invoice amounts and compared to PO-7789 in ProcureFlow.
3) Identified two mismatches: (a) invoice contains a "Setup - On-prem Connector" hardware line (unit price 4,500 x 1) not present on PO; (b) training days billed as 6 days on invoice vs 5 days on PO, unit price matches.
4) Attempted auto-match -> failed. AP applied "Exception: PO mismatch" flag and routed to procurement for approval.

Logs / evidence referenced:
- AP validation log excerpt (BillMatrix) captured 2026-03-11 14:03 UTC: "Line-level mismatch: line 3 SKU not found on PO-7789"
- Screenshot of invoice (INV-2026-047) and PO-7789 (attached to ticket in Jira).
- ProcureFlow change history shows PO-7789 locked after approval on 2026-02-28.

Investigation notes:
- Procurement (Rina) confirmed PO-7789 was approved for SaaS onboarding & training only; no hardware purchase was authorized.
- Vendor (GreenByte) replied 2026-03-12 stating the hardware charge was for a one-off "gateway dongle" required for integration; vendor claims it was assumed to be billable.
- No approved change order exists in ProcureFlow.
- Finance policy requires either (A) vendor submits corrected invoice removing unauthorized hardware line, or (B) procurement issues a formal change order approving the additional charge with cost center and GL coding, before AP will release payment.

Next steps proposed:
- Procurement to reach vendor to request corrected invoice or submit change-order request (if business-authorized).
- If vendor provides corrected invoice, AP will re-run auto-validate and schedule payment in the next run.
- If procurement approves change order, update PO-7789 with new line and code to GL 5400/Onboarding and notify AP to reconcile.

Escalation: vendor account manager escalated to Sales on 2026-03-12. Sales contact: Priya Nair (internal), who offered to confirm whether hardware was requested by the onboarding team.

Business risk: Mid-term: vendor may pause onboarding services if not paid; short-term: holds impact cash flow but vendor is flagged as high-priority partner for integration.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:18 - Diego Ramos (AP): Triage complete. Auto-match failed due to extra hardware line. Flagged as 'PO mismatch'. Routing to procurement for approval. Attached invoice/PO screenshots.

2026-03-12 11:05 - Rina Patel (Procurement): Reviewed PO-7789. No hardware was approved. I will reach out to vendor and ask for corrected invoice or formal change order. Assigning to myself for vendor follow-up.

2026-03-12 14:42 - Vendor (GreenByte - acct mgmt): 'The gateway dongle is required for the integration. We assumed one-off charge would be accepted; can we get paid and then raise change order?' - Vendor requested expedited processing.

2026-03-12 15:10 - Priya Nair (Sales): Confirmed onboarding team never requested hardware. Will loop in customer success to verify if hardware is needed. Recommending vendor provide corrected invoice without hardware while we confirm.

2026-03-13 08:30 - Rina Patel (Procurement): Vendor offered to issue a credit memo for the hardware line. Waiting for vendor to confirm and send credit + corrected invoice. If not received by EOD 2026-03-15, we'll request a formal change-order approval with business justification.
2026-03-13 10:02 - Diego Ramos (AP): Noted — AP will await corrected invoice/credit memo. Once received, will run validation and queue for next payment cycle (week ending 2026-03-19).
resolution: Pending vendor credit memo or procurement-approved change order. Current interim plan: vendor to issue corrected invoice/credit memo removing unauthorized hardware line. AP will process payment after auto-validate passes. If change order approved instead, procurement will update PO-7789 and notify AP to reconcile. No payment released while ticket remains open.
